note: Attacker-controlled input bytes enter the fuzzer; the first two bytes are flags and the remainder is the JSON payload.
The JSON string is extracted from the input after the 2-byte prefix and passed to the parser.
A Parser is constructed with the monster schema loaded from monster_test.bfbs.
The JSON is parsed against the monster schema; the parser walks the JSON object fields in order.
Each parsed field value and its FieldDef are pushed onto field_stack_ in the order they appear in the JSON.
When parsing a union value inside a vector, the code reads the union type from vector_of_union_types at index count without verifying that count is within bounds.
The out-of-bounds read of vector_of_union_types->Get(count) reads 1 byte past the heap buffer, causing the heap-buffer-overflow READ 1 crash.
